title: Prime deliveries delayed
situation: High volume of late Prime deliveries is causing customer dissatisfaction and potential revenue loss.

params.reply_en: We see your order arrived later than promised. We’re investigating the cause and will improve timing. Expect a follow‑up soon.

params.title: Why is my Prime delivery late?
params.answer_en: Prime deliveries can be delayed due to high demand, carrier issues, or weather. We monitor and aim to resolve quickly.
params.answer_ar: قد يتأخر توصيل Prime بسبب الطلب العالي أو مشاكل الناقل أو الظروف الجوية. نتابع الأمر ونسعى لحله سريعًا.

reply_en: We see your order arrived later than promised. We’re investigating the cause and will improve timing. Expect a follow‑up soon.

title: Packages left in unsafe locations
situation: Drivers are leaving parcels in unsafe spots, risking theft and damage, requiring immediate response.

params.reply_en: We see your parcel was left in an unsafe spot. We’ll contact the carrier to improve delivery handling and will monitor for any issues. If the item is damaged or missing, let us know and we’ll arrange a replacement or refund.
params.reply_ar: نلاحظ أن طردك ترك في مكان غير آمن. سنتواصل مع شركة التوصيل لتحسين طريقة التسليم وسنراقب أي مشاكل. إذا كان الطرد متضررًا أو مفقودًا، أخبرنا وسنرتب استبدالًا أو استردادًا.

actions.why: inform customers and set expectation for follow‑up

params.title: Parcel left in unsafe location
params.answer_en: If a parcel is left in an unsafe or insecure location, contact support. We will investigate with the carrier and arrange a replacement or refund if the item is damaged or stolen.

title: Packages marked delivered but not received
situation: Customers see delivery as completed while their orders are missing, risking refunds and negative sentiment.
